text:
First-of-7 chat-server AGENTS.md landed in commit ac5cdb8. Per the bead's acceptance criterion 'Spot-check by Mark on the chat-server one (highest-velocity sibling) before the others land', re-labeling 'human' and setting status open pending Mark's spot-check.

The remaining 6 siblings to land once approved:
* crate-jmap-calendars-server/AGENTS.md
* crate-jmap-tasks-server/AGENTS.md
* crate-jmap-contacts-server/AGENTS.md
* crate-jmap-filenode-server/AGENTS.md
* crate-jmap-sharing-server/AGENTS.md
* crate-jmap-metadata-server/AGENTS.md

Each will mirror the chat-server shape with spec references and trait names swapped per each crate's actual spec / backend trait. The 'Permission enforcement: backend canonical' section in chat-server's AGENTS.md is a new section that mail-server (the canonical) does not yet have — once chat-server is approved as the sibling reference, a follow-up bead should propagate this section back into the canonical mail-server/AGENTS.md and across to the other 5 siblings to keep the family fully congruent.

Drop the 'human' label once spot-check is done; /do-beads can then continue with the remaining 6 siblings.
